name: realmforge
description: RealmForge — convenience scripts over the four standalone packages (no workspaces). Run `npm run setup` once.

scripts.setup: cd game-core && npm ci && cd ../contracts && npm ci && cd ../server && npm ci && cd ../web && npm ci
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:game-core && cd server && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:game-core && cd contracts && npx hardhat build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:game-core && cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../web && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:game-core && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:game-core && cd server && npm test
